entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Speak, ojel. The crews are listening.

variants.low: Not now. Off the pier.
variants.high: You are welcome here. Speak, I have time.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: The crews sleep below. Lower your voice, ojel.

variants.low: Night on the pier. Come at lamplight.
variants.high: Late, friend. Come in quietly.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: The hulls have heard of it.

variants.low: Every crew saw. Leave the planks.
variants.high: I saw that, friend. Mend it before the vote.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Step aboard, ojel. The crews know you.

variants.low: Step aboard. Mind the rail.
variants.high: Step aboard, friend. My crews trust you.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Fair water on your route, Compact blood.

variants.low: Fair water. Say it quickly.
variants.high: Fair water, friend. Ask me anything.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: I'm Opens-The-Books, the flotilla speaker, so I'll tell you where you stand. Four working hulls lie moored here as houses, one crew to a hull. Across the planks, the market sits on rafts, old plank ferries tied up for good. I watch both sides from my bow. The crews would call it the best berth in the bay.

variants.low: Four working hulls, moored as houses. The market rafts lie across the planks. That's all there is to see.
variants.high: Welcome, shore-foot. I'm Opens-The-Books, the flotilla speaker. Four working hulls lie moored here as houses, one crew to each. The market rafts lie across the planks from us. Try the raft nearest the trade ship first, the prices there suit a buyer.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Lilmoth sits on firm ground beside water too shallow for a big ship. The ships can't dock, so they anchor out in the deep. Our crews carry the cargo ashore from there, hold by hold. My hull is the largest, so the crews meet in my cabin to settle the day's work.

variants.low: The ships can't dock at Lilmoth. Our lighters carry their cargo ashore. Ask a hand for more.
variants.high: Big ships can't dock at Lilmoth, the water's too shallow. They anchor out in the deep. Our crews carry the cargo ashore, hold by hold. Come to my cabin when the crews meet. You'll hear how the days are planned.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: We live aboard the hulls we work. The Compact is our guild. It holds three posts here: the lighter's master, the purser and me as speaker. The council once tried to make us buy licences for lightering. I called the vote. The crews stopped the port, two full weeks of it.

variants.low: We live on our hulls. The council tried licences once. The port stood still two weeks. Good day.
variants.high: We live aboard the hulls we work, shore-foot. The Compact holds three posts here: lighter's master, purser and me as speaker. When the council tried licences for lightering, I called the vote. The port stood stopped two weeks. Ask Xal-Jei about that run, he cast off none.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Slaughterfish work the water under our hulls. The osheeja gar do too. Walk the middle of the planks and keep your hands inside the rail. We coil our lines on deck by habit now.

variants.low: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the hulls. Stay off the edge.
variants.high: Slaughterfish work the water under our hulls, shore-foot. The osheeja gar do too. Walk the middle of the planks and keep your hands inside the rail. I'll send a hand to walk you out if you're nervous.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: On foot, take the landing stage from the pier foot over the reeds. It meets the Lilmoth track. By water, boats leave this pier bound for the anchorage, or for Archon. Ask the lighter's master when the next one goes. He casts off only on my nod, so you've come to the right hull.

variants.low: Landing stage for the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage or Archon leave the pier. Go.
variants.high: Take the landing stage over the reeds if you're walking. It meets the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage or for Archon leave the pier too. I'll nod the lighter's master off early for you, shore-foot.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: I speak for the lighter crews whenever the Lilmoth council writes to us. I stand at the bow of a longboat and call the whole crew to a vote on the letter. No hull casts off without my nod. That's the custom here. Once the vote went for a stoppage. The port sat dead for two weeks.

variants.low: I speak for the crews when the council writes. They vote. No hull moves without my nod. Once they stopped the port two weeks.
variants.high: I speak for the lighter crews whenever the council writes to us, shore-foot. I stand at a longboat's bow and call a vote on the letter. No hull casts off without my nod. Once the crews voted a stoppage. The port sat dead two weeks. Come to a vote sometime, they're worth seeing.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: The Compact is our guild. It covers the boat crews, the routes they run and the ferries. I hold the speaker's post in it here. A council at Lilmoth once tried to license the cargo boats. I called the vote. The crews answered with two weeks of stoppage.

variants.low: The Compact is the guild of the boat crews. A council licensed nothing. Two weeks of stoppage settled that.
variants.high: The Compact is our guild, shore-foot. It covers the boat crews, their routes and the ferries. When a council at Lilmoth tried to license the cargo boats, they met two weeks of stoppage. I called that vote myself. Join us at the next one if you like.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: The Reed-Sail Compact runs the boats, up the rivers and along the coast. It's the guild that gathers the crews, the routes and the ferries. The pirates they call the Salt-Teeth sail among its crews, so a good name on a hull can cover a raider. Ask whose hull it is before you pay for passage.

variants.low: The Compact is the boat guild. It runs the river and coast boats. Salt-Teeth pirates sail among them. Be careful.
variants.high: The Compact runs the boats on the rivers and the coast, shore-foot. It's the guild of the crews, the routes and the ferries. Pirates they call the Salt-Teeth sail among its crews. I'll point you to an honest hull if you tell me where you're bound.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Later, shore-foot.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Lines out, hands up.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Out to the ships, passenger?

variants.low: No fare, no boat, passenger.
variants.high: Out to the ships, passenger? I will take you myself.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: The next water turns near dawn.

variants.low: Nothing moves till dawn.
variants.high: Dawn, passenger. I will find you a place aboard.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Put it back before I call the speaker.

variants.low: Hands off the cargo.
variants.high: Put it back, passenger. I saw nothing.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Back at the pier? Mind the wet planks.

variants.low: Wet planks. Step careful.
variants.high: Back at the pier, passenger! The planks are wet, so mind your step.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: A guild man? Then take the tiller seat and sit easy.

variants.low: Guild or not, wait for the nod.
variants.high: A guild man, passenger? Take the tiller seat. I will fetch the lines.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Four working hulls are moored here for good. We live in them the way townsfolk live in houses. They lie in a row along a timber pier that runs out from Lilmoth's east bank. I'm the lighter's master. I take the Lilmoth lighter out from the pier head to the ships.

variants.low: Four working hulls, moored as homes. A timber pier off Lilmoth's east bank. I run the lighter. That's all you need.
variants.high: Four working hulls are moored here for good. We live in them like townsfolk in houses. They lie in a row on a timber pier off Lilmoth's east bank. I'm the lighter's master. Come to the pier head and I'll show you the boat myself.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Whatever a ship brings into this bay reaches the quay in a lighter's hold, every sack of it. I stand at the lines and the lighter doesn't cast off until the speaker gives the nod. A load goes out on one turn of the water and comes back on the next.

variants.low: Cargo comes ashore in a lighter's hold. Nothing sails before the speaker's nod.
variants.high: Whatever a ship brings into this bay reaches the quay in a lighter's hold, every sack of it. I wait at the lines for the speaker's nod, then we cast off. Come aboard at the pier head and watch a load go over.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: The council wanted every lighter licensed once, a paper for work it never did. We stopped the whole port for two weeks over that. Not a cask came ashore. The merchants who rule Lilmoth found out what a lighter's hold is worth. It's not a story the boat folk tire of telling on a slow evening.

variants.low: The council wanted a licence and we stopped the port for two weeks. Ask the merchants how that went.
variants.high: The council wanted every lighter licensed once, a paper for work it never did. We stopped the whole port for two weeks over that. Not a cask came ashore. The merchants who rule Lilmoth still talk softly to us. Sit on the pier and I'll tell you how the vote went.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim right under the hulls. Whatever drops off the pier is theirs. I let it go.

variants.low: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the hulls. Stay off the edge.
variants.high: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim right under the hulls. Whatever drops off the pier is theirs. I'll find you a pole if you need a line fetched.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: On foot, go to the pier foot and cross the landing stage over the reeds. It meets the Lilmoth track on the far side. By water, there's the anchorage run. Boats for Archon sail from the same planks as well. I work the anchorage run myself, out on one turn of the water and back on the next.

variants.low: Landing stage over the reeds for the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and Archon leave from the pier. Pick one.
variants.high: On foot, go to the pier foot and cross the landing stage over the reeds. It meets the Lilmoth track on the far side. By water, I run the anchorage myself and boats for Archon sail from the same planks. Tell me where you're bound and I'll point you at the right one.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Out at the anchorage, the deep-water ships need a boat to meet them. That boat is a lighter. It takes their cargo off them. Anything those ships bring reaches Lilmoth in a lighter's hold. I'm the master of the Lilmoth lighter, so I cast off. She carries passengers too. They weigh less than a sack and complain more. She runs from the city pier out to the anchorage and back.

variants.low: A lighter meets the deep-water ships and carries all their cargo ashore in her hold. I'm master of the Lilmoth lighter and I cast off. She takes passengers between the city pier and the anchorage.
variants.high: Out at the anchorage, the deep-water ships need a boat to meet them. That boat is a lighter. It takes the cargo off them. Anything they bring reaches Lilmoth in a lighter's hold. I'm the master of the Lilmoth lighter, so I cast off. She runs passengers from the city pier out to the anchorage. Ride along once and you'll see how the bay works.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: I hold a post in the Compact, the guild of the boats. It settles the share each crew takes on a route before anyone casts off. The posts are why the run stays in our hands.

variants.low: The Compact is the guild. It fixes the share each crew takes on a route. Pay it or ask the speaker.
variants.high: I hold a post in the Compact, the guild of the boats. It settles the share each crew takes on a route before anyone casts off. The posts are why the run stays in our hands. Ask me about any route and I'll tell you who works it.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Lilmoth stands over shallow water, so the big ships have to anchor out in the bay. Merchants sit as a council and rule it. Umbriel, the flying city, destroyed it in 4E 48. They built it again, smaller.

variants.low: Lilmoth stands over shallow water, so big ships anchor out. Merchants rule it. Umbriel, a flying city, destroyed it in 4E 48. It was built again smaller.
variants.high: Lilmoth stands over shallow water, so the big ships have to anchor out in the bay. Merchants sit as a council and rule it. Umbriel, the flying city, destroyed it in 4E 48. They built it again, smaller. I'll point out the new quay from the pier head if you like.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Clear the line.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: Wait for the nod.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: My heels are sore, friend. Ask quickly.

variants.low: My heels hurt. Speak or leave.
variants.high: Friend, sit on the rail. Ask me.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: I cannot sleep. Too hot below.

variants.low: I am trying to sleep. Do not wake a hand off his turn.
variants.high: Friend, you are up late too. Ask quietly.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: That was theft. The speaker will hear.

variants.low: Off our planks.
variants.high: Friend, that is a bad turn. The speaker will hear.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: My turn is done. Ask, friend.

variants.low: My turn is done. Hurry.
variants.high: Friend, my turn is done. Ask what you like.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: I'm a lighter hand. I live aboard one of four boats lashed along a single timber pier on the east bank. The market floats on rafts on the far side of the planks. I cross them barefoot, so the salt has cracked my heels.

variants.low: Four boats on one timber pier, east bank. The market rafts float on the far side of it. Go and look.
variants.high: I'm a lighter hand, friend. I live aboard one of four boats lashed along a single timber pier on the east bank. The market floats on rafts across the planks. Buy there before noon, while the sacks are full.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: A big ship stays out in deep water, because Lilmoth has no dock for her. We row out to her anchorage and fetch what she carries.

variants.low: Lilmoth has no dock for a big ship. We fetch the cargo from where she anchors.
variants.high: A big ship stays out in deep water, because Lilmoth has no dock for her. We row out to her anchorage and fetch what she carries. If you want passage out there, the master is Xal-Jei.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: Four of us hands sleep in the bunks below the foredeck, all in a row. I like it there. When the council tried to write a licence for our work, we stopped the port. It lasted two weeks.

variants.low: We hands share the bunks below the foredeck. The council wrote a licence once, so we stopped the port for two weeks.
variants.high: Four of us hands sleep in the bunks below the foredeck, all in a row. I like it there. When the council tried to write a licence for our work, we stopped the port. It lasted two weeks. The speaker, Opens-The-Books, called that vote.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the boats. I wash from a bucket on deck and not over the side.

variants.low: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the boats. Stay off the edge.
variants.high: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the boats. I wash from a bucket on deck and not over the side. Wear boots on the planks. Your toes stay yours that way.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: Walk to the foot of the pier and cross the landing stage over the reeds. The Lilmoth track starts at the far end of it. Boats to the anchorage and to Archon push off from the pier itself.

variants.low: Cross the landing stage over the reeds to the Lilmoth track. Anchorage and Archon boats leave from the pier.
variants.high: Walk to the foot of the pier and cross the landing stage over the reeds. The Lilmoth track starts at the far end of it. Boats to the anchorage and to Archon push off from the pier itself. Ask for Xal-Jei if you want a seat on the anchorage run.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: No deep hull can dock at Lilmoth. So the lighter goes out to the anchorage and I haul the loads down into her belly. After that, we pole her home. I do it all on bare planks.

variants.low: No deep hull can dock at Lilmoth. I haul loads from the anchorage into the lighter.
variants.high: No deep hull can dock at Lilmoth. So the lighter goes out to the anchorage and I haul the loads down into her belly. After that, we pole her home. Teeb-Rekh coils the lines and Cold Nakka bails her dry.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: Slick planks today.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: One more haul.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Stranger. You look light. No cargo today?

variants.low: Mind the lines. My hands are full.
variants.high: Stranger. You found the stage again.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Late, stranger. The hulls are dark.

variants.low: Late. Off the planks.
variants.high: Late, stranger. Step softly past the foredeck.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: That cargo has an owner.

variants.low: Drop it.
variants.high: Put it down, stranger. I will say nothing this once.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Come aboard, stranger. The planks are wet.

variants.low: Aboard, then. Be fast about it.
variants.high: Come aboard. Sit by the lines. The deep-water hands told me things.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: We live on four hulls, moored for good along the pier. The market rafts lie across the planks from us. Untaxed goods sell there.

variants.low: Four hulls moored as houses. Market rafts on the far side. Look for yourself.
variants.high: We live on four hulls, moored for good along the pier. The market rafts lie across the planks from us. Bring coin there, because the tariff men never see what sells.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Every cargo in the bay comes ashore in a lighter's hold. I haul it down into ours from the anchorage. I've carried the weight of the pier by evening.

variants.low: Cargo comes ashore in a lighter's hold. I haul it. That is all.
variants.high: Every cargo in the bay comes ashore in a lighter's hold. I haul it down into ours from the anchorage. Ask me the weight of any crate and I will tell you.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Over a licence for lightering, the hands here shut the port two weeks. The deep-water hands say a council man now talks of dredging a channel.

variants.low: The hands shut the port two weeks over a licence. Ask the council.
variants.high: Over a licence for lightering, the hands here shut the port two weeks. The deep-water hands say a council man now talks of dredging a channel. I hear most at the anchorage.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Under the hulls swim slaughterfish and osheeja gar. Stay off the edge of the planks.

variants.low: Fish under the hulls. Gar too. Stay off the edge.
variants.high: Under the hulls swim slaughterfish and osheeja gar. Stay off the edge of the planks. Trailing a hand is how a hand is lost.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: On foot, take the landing stage from the foot of the pier. It ends at the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and Archon push off from the pier.

variants.low: Landing stage, then the Lilmoth track. Boats for Archon leave from the pier.
variants.high: On foot, take the landing stage from the foot of the pier. It ends at the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and Archon push off from the pier. The Archon ones fill early.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: A large ship cannot dock at Lilmoth. She anchors out in the bay. I haul crates over her side and down into the lighter's hold.

variants.low: Large ships cannot dock at Lilmoth. I haul the cargo to the lighter's hold.
variants.high: A large ship cannot dock at Lilmoth. She anchors out in the bay. I haul crates over her side and down into the lighter's hold. A good lifter learns to lean.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Stand clear.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Heavy one. Two on this.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Visitor, my cup is not shared.

variants.low: Buy your own, visitor.
variants.high: Good day, visitor. Rafts pour fair today.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Dark, visitor. Say it, then go.

variants.low: Dark and cold. Rye first, talk later.
variants.high: Dark out, visitor. Rest here a bit.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Hands to yourself, visitor, or I shout.

variants.low: Off this deck, visitor.
variants.high: Careful, visitor. I saw that hand.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Sit, ojel. I pour you one.

variants.low: You, ojel. One cup, then home.
variants.high: Sit, ojel. The good rye is yours.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: The hulls lie in a row along a timber pier, east of Lilmoth. Across the planks, the market rafts sell what the tariff line misses. I buy my rye there. The pour is full.

variants.low: The hulls sit in a row at a timber pier, east of Lilmoth. Rafts across the planks. Buy there or do not.
variants.high: The hulls sit in a row at a timber pier, east of Lilmoth. Across the planks, the rafts sell good rye. I will show you the stall with the fullest pour.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Lilmoth has no dock for the big ships. They drop anchor in deep water. We bring the cargo in on the lighter. I coil the lines on deck. A flat coil is one a hand can step over in the dark.

variants.low: No dock at Lilmoth takes a big ship. We bring the cargo ashore. I coil lines. Do not stand on them.
variants.high: No dock at Lilmoth takes a big ship, so it anchors out. We bring the cargo in on the lighter. Come watch me coil one day. I will name each rope for you.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: The hands on the lighter pull together. The city needs every boat in the bay at the same hour, so the posts need us. Opens-The-Books holds the speaker's post. The talking is hers.

variants.low: We pull together. The posts talk. I coil.
variants.high: The hands on the lighter pull together. The posts need every boat in the bay. Opens-The-Books holds the speaker's post. She is fair. I say so freely.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar feed in the water under these hulls. Coil your lines inboard. Stand off the rail when a load swings.

variants.low: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar. Stay off the rail.
variants.high: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar feed under these hulls. Stand off the rail when a load swings. I will pull you back by the belt if you forget.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: On foot, cross the landing stage from the foot of the pier, over the reeds, to the Lilmoth track. Boats for Archon and boats for the anchorage push off from the pier itself. Buy your rye on the rafts first. It's better here.

variants.low: Landing stage, then the Lilmoth track. Boats for Archon leave from the pier.
variants.high: Cross the landing stage over the reeds to the Lilmoth track. Archon boats and anchorage boats leave from the pier. Buy your rye on the rafts first. It's better here.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Between runs, I bail the bilge dry, then coil the lines flat. I sleep in a bunk under the foredeck. After a wet run, I pour a cup of rye and weigh the day against it.

variants.low: I bail between runs. I sleep in a bunk under the foredeck.
variants.high: I bail between runs, then coil the lines flat. I sleep in a bunk under the foredeck. After a hard run, I pour you a cup too.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Rafts are selling.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Flat coil, flat deck.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Landsman. Come to see the beetle?

variants.low: Not now, landsman. The lighter is loading.
variants.high: Landsman! He has been waiting for a visitor.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Only the beetle is up now.

variants.low: Dark hour, landsman. Wake a neighbour.
variants.high: Awake too? Sit down and see his box.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: That was not yours, landsman. Set it right.

variants.low: Set it back or I call the pier.
variants.high: Easy, landsman. Hand it over.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Friend, come and meet the beetle.

variants.low: He is in the box. Look quickly.
variants.high: Come and meet him. He likes company.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: A pier runs out from Lilmoth's east bank. Four boats lie moored along one side, each a home. The market rafts float on the far side, so you cross the planks to shop. The tariff men don't see what's sold there. I work the lighter off the pier head. My box sits by my bunk.

variants.low: Pier, boats, rafts across the planks. Go and look.
variants.high: Walk the planks and see the market rafts on the far side. Tell the sellers I sent you. They'll show you the good stock before the tariff men sniff it out.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: I'm a hand on the lighter, the flat boat that goes out to the big ships. Every cargo in the bay comes ashore in a lighter's hold, so there's always something to haul. Between runs I bail her out. Those with posts say when we go. I do the pole and the bucket.

variants.low: I haul. Every cargo in the bay comes ashore in a lighter's hold. That's the work.
variants.high: Every cargo in the bay lands in a lighter's hold, so a strong back never starves here. Ask at the pier head if you want a day's hauling. Xal-Jei gives the nod.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: We live aboard the boats we work. Your neighbour is whoever's rail is next to yours. Compact dues I'd sooner spend backing my beetle at Archon. I say so to anyone. I hear a council man talks of dredging a deep channel. Big ships would dock then. The lighters would have no work.

variants.low: Boat people. Some pay the Compact. I don't.
variants.high: We live aboard the boats we work. We look out for each other. I hear a council man talks of dredging a deep channel. Big ships would dock then, so listen for more of that talk and tell me.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the hulls. I bail from the deck and don't lean over to see how it's going. The beetle is safer company than anything that dangles.

variants.low: Slaughterfish and gar. Don't dangle anything.
variants.high: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar swim under the hulls, so stay on the planks. If you drop something, wave me over. I'll hook it back with the pole.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: To walk out, take the landing stage from the pier foot across the reed shallows. It meets the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and Archon cast off from this pier. I go to Archon for the fights when I can. I'd board that boat.

variants.low: Landing stage, then the track. Boats leave too.
variants.high: Cross the landing stage over the reeds to the Lilmoth track. For Archon, board at the pier. Go to the fights, they're worth the fare. Bring your own luck.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Lightering is carrying cargo from the ships to the quay, because big ones can't dock at Lilmoth. A hand bails the lighter between runs. I bail longer than I'd like. I sleep below the foredeck in a bunk, with the beetle's box beside it. Bilge in the bunks is my one complaint.

variants.low: Haul, bail, sleep in a bunk. That's lightering.
variants.high: Lightering is carrying cargo from ships that can't dock. A hand bails between runs and sleeps in a bunk. I've got used to that. Ask me for the bailing lesson. It's an honest job.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: He is hungry today, landsman.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Bail, tip, bail.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Mind the net on the deck, walker.

variants.low: Step wide of the net.
variants.high: Walker. Sit by the net, there is room.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Still up, walker. The lamp is low.

variants.low: My needle wants the lamp. Walk softly.
variants.high: Still up, walker. Sit by the lamp while it lasts.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Hands off, ojel.

variants.low: Hands to yourself, ojel.
variants.high: Hands off that, walker. Ask me first.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Stand by me, then. The net is no trouble to you.

variants.low: Stay clear of the net, ojel.
variants.high: Stand by me, walker. Take the stool. Take this end.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: I mend nets on the deck of the south hull, so I'll start with the hulls. Four tarred working boats lie bow-in along this pier, each one a home moored for good. There's a split in the third strand of a haul line in my lap right now. The rafts across the pier are the market. Go there with coin.

variants.low: Four hulls, moored as houses along this pier. The market rafts are across it. I have a split strand to finish.
variants.high: Four tarred hulls lie bow-in along this pier, all moored as houses. I'm on the south one with a split haul line in my lap. Bring me a frayed strap and I'll mend it while you look. The rafts across the pier sell what the tariff line never sees.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Lilmoth sits on shallow ground, so a big ship cannot dock at its quay. She anchors far out in the bay and the lighters go out to her. I don't haul. I mend the lines and nets the haulers tear. The tariff men do not pass our moorings. That suits a net-mender fine.

variants.low: A big ship cannot dock at Lilmoth. The lighters go out to her. I mend, I don't haul.
variants.high: Lilmoth sits on shallow ground, so a big ship cannot dock at its quay. She anchors far out in the bay and the lighters go out to her. I mend what the haulers tear. Come at dusk, once the lines are tied off. I splice then.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: The Compact holds the three posts here. I belong to no guild, so I pay it no share. I mend for whoever brings a net. At dusk, the hands cook on deck, hull beside hull. The smoke reaches my stool by the south rail before the lamps are lit.

variants.low: The Compact holds the posts. I pay it no share. Bring a net or go.
variants.high: The Compact holds the three posts here. I belong to no guild, so I pay it no share. I mend for whoever brings a net. That includes you. Sit on the rope coil if you want to talk.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Slaughterfish swim thick below the hulls here. The osheeja gar prowl there too. When I work the low end of a net, where the mesh trails toward the water, I sit well back from the deck's edge.

variants.low: Slaughterfish below the hulls. Osheeja gar too. Stay off the edge.
variants.high: Slaughterfish swim thick below the hulls here. The osheeja gar prowl there too. Tie your pack to the rail with a cord. I'll lend you one, so nothing dangles over the side.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: From the foot of the pier, a landing stage runs out over the reed shallows to the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and boats for Archon both leave from the planks beside my hull. South along the track, a few minutes on foot, is the divers' yard. I like to see a walker go off the right way.

variants.low: Landing stage, then the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and Archon leave from the pier.
variants.high: From the foot of the pier, a landing stage runs out over the reed shallows to the Lilmoth track. Boats for the anchorage and for Archon leave from the planks beside my hull. If the track is too far tonight, the trade ship at the pier head has bunks to let.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: I make torn nets sound again. Worn gear too. I do it in the open on the deck of the south hull, where anyone passing can watch my hands. Anyone may bring me a net. This tear in my lap is a hand-span long. I'll give you its worth before I start.

variants.low: I make torn nets sound again. I do it in the open. Anyone may bring a net, you too.
variants.high: I make torn nets sound again. Worn gear too. I do it in the open on the deck of the south hull, where anyone passing can watch my hands. Anyone may bring me a net. Bring yours and I'll show you the knot as I tie it.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Mind the net, walker.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Loop it. Tight.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Customer. Goods today, or a bunk?

variants.low: The counter is for buyers.
variants.high: Customer, good. I have something off the tariff line today.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Bunks below, if you are tired.

variants.low: Bunks are paid before anyone sleeps.
variants.high: A bunk below is ready for you tonight.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: I have you in the book as owing.

variants.low: Pay what is written or leave.
variants.high: Settle the page and the line is gone.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Back again, customer. I laid out your goods.

variants.low: Goods are on the counter. Pay first.
variants.high: Customer, good to see you. I set the best aside.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: A Compact hand? Then I mark you in the book as ours.

variants.low: Compact or not, you pay like the rest.
variants.high: Compact hand! Your page in my book is clear.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: I'm the purser on the Alten Meerhleel trade ship, so the pier head is where I sit and count. Off Lilmoth's east bank, a single timber pier carries the whole row of hulls, bow-in on its south side. Most are tarred black and few would pass a survey. They float, all of them. People live in each one. At dusk, I like the masts with the cooking smoke between them.

variants.low: The pier is public. My counter is not a place to loiter.
variants.high: I'm the purser on the Alten Meerhleel trade ship, so the pier head is where I sit and count. Off Lilmoth's east bank, a single timber pier carries the whole row of hulls, bow-in on its south side. Most are tarred black, but they float and they're warm inside. Come at dusk, when the smoke rises between the masts.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Nothing off the anchorage gets to Lilmoth except down in a lighter's hold. My own ship's stores go ashore that way as well. I tick each lot off my book at the pier head before it goes down the side. What I sell from the stores below stays out of the tariff line, so my counter is busier than the quay clerks like.

variants.low: Cargo goes ashore in a lighter. That is all I'll say for free.
variants.high: Nothing off the anchorage gets to Lilmoth except down in a lighter's hold. My stores go that way too. I tick each lot off my book before it goes down the side. Buy from my counter and the tariff clerks never see the sum. It suits us both.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: The boatmen live aboard the hulls they work. I have one of the three posts the Compact fills here, the purser's. The lighter people back one another because the city needs them all at once. I counted what the stoppage cost us, line by line. The total stays in my book. Ask me a price instead, because those I say aloud.

variants.low: They live on their hulls. I count the ship's books, not their business.
variants.high: The boatmen live aboard the hulls they work. The purser's post is mine. They back one another because the city needs them all at once. I counted what that stoppage cost, line by line. The total stays in my book. Ask me any price you like. Those I say aloud.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar prowl under the planks and around the hulls. A bale that goes over the rail is struck from my book that same minute.

variants.low: Fish in the water. Keep off the edge.
variants.high: Slaughterfish and osheeja gar prowl under the planks. Lean over the rail for a dropped bale and you'll be struck from my book that same minute. I'd rather sell you a new bale.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Walkers leave by the landing stage from the pier foot, across the reeds to the Lilmoth track. By water, you board at the pier for the anchorage or for Archon. Along that track south, a few minutes' walk, you reach Under-Yard.

variants.low: Stage for the track. Pier for the boats.
variants.high: Walkers leave by the landing stage from the pier foot, across the reeds to the Lilmoth track. By water, you board at the pier for the anchorage or for Archon. Along that track south, a few minutes' walk, you reach Under-Yard. I like the walk.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: I keep the books for the trade ship. Goods come aboard. Goods go out. I write every line. I sell the ship's goods untaxed from my counter. Anyone who pays the fare gets a bunk below deck. Bunks let, bunks empty, goods received, goods sold. I read the page that way each evening.

variants.low: Books, stores, bunks. Pay the fare or go.
variants.high: I keep the books for the trade ship. Goods come aboard. Goods go out. I write every line. I sell the ship's goods untaxed from my counter. Anyone who pays the fare gets a bunk below deck. Bunks let, bunks empty, goods received, goods sold. I read it out to myself each evening.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: The Compact has its monopoly because it can stop the port. The council knows it. I only know the ledger side. The ledger says that stoppage was dear.

variants.low: The Compact stops the port when it likes. That is all.
variants.high: The Compact has its monopoly because it can stop the port. The council knows it. I only know the ledger side. I'd call that stoppage dear. The figure stays in my book.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: The Compact is the guild of the boatmen, their routes and their ferries. Along the rivers and the coast, its members run the boats. The Salt-Teeth, a pirate band, sail under its name too. A hull wearing the Compact's mark can still be a raider's.

variants.low: A guild of boats. Pirates sail in it. Draw your own line.
variants.high: The Compact is the guild of the boatmen, their routes and their ferries. Along the rivers and the coast, its members run the boats. The Salt-Teeth, a pirate band, sail under its name too. A hull wearing the Compact's mark can still be a raider's. Look at the cargo before you trust the paint.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Counter is open, customer.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
entries.words: Show me your slip.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: We say ojel for an outsider. You are ojel here. It carries no insult. Argonians who hatch outside Black Marsh cannot hear the Hist. Some use a bad word for them. I will not repeat it. Who says it on this pier is my business.

variants.low: Ojel means outsider. It is no insult. Argonians hatched outside Black Marsh cannot hear the Hist.
variants.high: We say ojel for an outsider. It carries no insult here. Argonians hatched outside Black Marsh cannot hear the Hist. Some use a bad word for them. I will not repeat it.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: It means an outsider. That's you. It's a plain word with no insult in it. Port folk say it without heat. Ask what the word cost anyone in the old days and I'll tell you about my beetle instead. Inland they may say it with a frown, but that's their business.

variants.low: Outsider. No insult in it. Ask a neighbour.
variants.high: Ojel is a plain word with no insult in it. You are welcome here whatever it calls you. Port folk say it without heat. Inland they may frown, so watch your manners there.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: To an Argonian, ojel means an outsider and carries no insult. You are one. The word to avoid is lukiul. The An-Xileel coined that slur for Argonians raised outside Black Marsh. They cannot hear the Hist. I do not say it on this deck. Who sided with whom in Lilmoth in forty-eight, I do not say either.

variants.low: Ojel means an outsider. That is you. Lukiul is the An-Xileel's slur for Argonians raised outside Black Marsh. Do not say it here.
variants.high: To an Argonian, ojel means an outsider and carries no insult. Say it of yourself on the pier and you'll be understood. Lukiul is the word to avoid. The An-Xileel coined that slur for Argonians raised outside Black Marsh. I do not say it on this deck.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: It's the floating quarter off Lilmoth's east bank. I speak for it. Four old hulls that carried cargo ashore now serve as our houses, lined along a single timber pier. The market rafts lie across the planks from us. The crews would vote the quarter a fair place to live.

variants.low: The floating quarter off the east bank. Four old hulls as houses on one pier, rafts across the planks.
variants.high: It's the floating quarter off Lilmoth's east bank, shore-foot. Four old hulls that carried cargo ashore now serve as our houses, lined along a single timber pier. The market rafts lie across from us. Walk over, I'll vouch for you at the first raft.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: Lilmoth is the southern port. It's built over shallow water, which is why big ships anchor out and we carry their cargo in from the deep. Merchants sit on its council to rule the port. They write to me when they want something. Umbriel, the flying city, destroyed it in 4E 48. What stands now went up smaller.

variants.low: Lilmoth is the southern port on shallow water. Merchants rule it. Umbriel destroyed it in 4E 48. It was rebuilt smaller.
variants.high: Lilmoth is the southern port, shore-foot, built over shallow water. That's why we carry the cargo in from the anchorage. Merchants sit on its council to rule. Umbriel, the flying city, destroyed it in 4E 48. It went up smaller after. Walk the track to see it.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
entries.words: This is the Lighter Flotilla, a quarter afloat on the water by Lilmoth's east bank. Its houses are four hulls that haul cargo to shore, tied in a row beside a single timber pier. On the pier's far side lie the market rafts.

variants.low: The Lighter Flotilla. Four hulls beside one timber pier, market rafts opposite.
variants.high: This is the Lighter Flotilla, a quarter afloat on the water by Lilmoth's east bank. Its houses are four hulls that haul cargo to shore, tied in a row beside a single timber pier. The market rafts lie on the far side. The sellers don't mind a browser. Cross the planks and look.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: It is a floating quarter off Lilmoth's east bank. Four old hulls serve as houses along one timber pier. The market rafts float on its far side.

variants.low: A floating quarter off Lilmoth's east bank. Four hulls as houses on one pier, rafts on the far side.
variants.high: It is a floating quarter off Lilmoth's east bank. Four old hulls serve as houses along one timber pier. The market rafts float on its far side. Buy from them before noon.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
entries.words: Lilmoth stands over shallow water. Merchants sit on its council and rule it. Umbriel is a flying city. It destroyed Lilmoth in 4E 48 and the town was rebuilt smaller.

variants.low: Shallow water. Merchants on the council. Umbriel, a flying city, destroyed it in 4E 48. Rebuilt smaller.
variants.high: Lilmoth stands over shallow water. Merchants sit on its council and rule it. Umbriel is a flying city. It destroyed Lilmoth in 4E 48 and the town was rebuilt smaller. The deep ships still anchor far out.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Four old hulls sit side by side at one timber pier. They carried cargo ashore once. Now hands live in them like houses. The market rafts float on the far side.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
entries.words: Lilmoth sits over shallow water, so the big ships anchor out and lighters carry the cargo ashore. Merchants sit on the council that runs the city. In 4E 48, Umbriel, the flying city, destroyed it. It was rebuilt smaller.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Four hulls lie moored as houses beside one timber pier at Lilmoth's east bank. The market rafts float on the far side. I sleep beside the speaker's hull and work the lighter at the pier head. Whatever the council or the Compact plans, we hear it on that pier first.

variants.low: Four hulls, one pier, rafts opposite. Look yourself.
variants.high: Four hulls moored as houses by one timber pier, rafts opposite. Come and see the beetle, then buy something on the rafts. Lilmoth's news arrives there before it's printed.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
entries.words: Lilmoth is the port in the south, on shallow water. Big ships anchor out. Small boats like mine carry cargo ashore. A merchants' council rules it. One of them talks of dredging a deep channel, I hear. The flying city Umbriel destroyed Lilmoth in 4E 48. It came back smaller.

variants.low: Port in the south, shallow water. A council runs it. Umbriel destroyed it in 4E 48. Smaller now.
variants.high: Lilmoth is the southern port, on shallow water, with a merchants' council. Umbriel destroyed it in 4E 48 and it came back smaller. If they dredge, we lose our work. Hear anything, tell me.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: Call it the flotilla. It is four old boats that once worked cargo and are houses now. They sit side by side along a timber pier on the east side of Lilmoth. The market rafts float on the far side of that pier.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
entries.words: Lilmoth stands in shallows, so deep hulls anchor far out and small boats ferry cargo to the quay. Merchants sit on the council that runs the town. The flying city Umbriel wrecked it in 4E 48. They built it again, smaller.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: We are the Lighter Flotilla. Four old hulls that used to ferry cargo are our houses now. They lie side by side along a timber pier off Lilmoth's east bank. The market rafts float on the far side of it.

variants.low: Four old hulls on a pier, with market rafts across it. That is the flotilla.
variants.high: We are the Lighter Flotilla. Four old hulls that used to ferry cargo are our houses now. They lie side by side along a timber pier off Lilmoth's east bank. The market rafts float on the far side of it. Walk the planks and I'll name you the knots on each hull.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
entries.words: Lilmoth is the port. Our pier starts from its east bank. It stands on shallow water. The big ships anchor far out and small boats ferry the cargo to the quay. A council of merchants rules the town. In 4E 48, the flying city Umbriel destroyed Lilmoth. Folk raised it again, smaller. I hear the council men sign licences for work they did not do.

variants.low: Lilmoth is the port up the track. A council of merchants rules it. Umbriel destroyed it in 4E 48. It was rebuilt smaller. Shallow water, so ships anchor out.

variants.low: Four hulls beside a timber pier off Lilmoth's east bank, now houses. The market rafts float on its far side.

In 4E 48, the flying city Umbriel wrecked it. It was rebuilt smaller, customer. The ledgers are tidier for it.

entries.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
entries.words: The council at Lilmoth wants every lighter licensed. They tried it once and I called the vote that shut the port for two weeks. Go and ask Xal-Jei, the lighter's master, for the crews' terms. Then take them up to the council yourself. The crews will vote on whatever you bring back, mind.

variants.low: The council wants lightering licensed. The port stood shut two weeks last time. Get the crews' terms from Xal-Jei, then take them to the council.

entries.words: Not every load goes over the quay. Some comes ashore in the dark, a turn of the water before dawn. The sums are settled across the dice tables. Reeh-Tei mends nets on the south hull and she sees what drifts past them. Ask her.

entries.words: Cargo does come ashore at night, past my moorings. It never crosses the quay. I'm laying a short splice in a haul line as I tell you. Those loads are settled at the dice tables on the Outside Barge. The tariff men don't pass my moorings, so they hear nothing of it.

entries.words: The flotilla speaker, Opens-The-Books, keeps a tally of her own. It lists cargo that left a hull and never reached the quay. I'd have that tally in my hands. Take it from her unseen, then bring it to me.
